summary: A done-for-you AI receptionist for Open Dental practices, sold through dental marketing agencies

recommended.why: Just under the cheapest named competitor, plus a $500 setup fee

must.feature: Answers after hours and at lunch

must.why: Retyping bookings is the top complaint

levers.change: Sell done-for-you setup at $500 plus $299/month instead of $199/month self-serve
levers.evidence: Dental AI receptionists list at $299-500/month; a done-for-you setup fee is common for practice software

moves.why: $3,960 lifetime gross profit against about $900 to win a practice
Priced inside the market, sold as a service

prerequisites.what: A setup checklist that takes under 2 hours per practice

levers.change: Resell through 2 dental marketing agencies on a 20% revenue share
levers.evidence: Dental marketing agencies already sell call tracking to the same practices

moves.why: The agency already has the trust

levers.change: Only Open Dental practices, with booking straight into Open Dental
levers.evidence: Competitors integrate Dentrix and Eaglesoft first

moves.why: The only one booking into Open Dental

ltv_cac.note: $3,960 lifetime gross profit against about $900 to win a practice

pricing_power.note: Priced inside the market, sold as a service

build_effort.note: Voice API + Open Dental slot/booking API: ~4-6 weeks at 10 h/week; HIPAA setup on top.

skills_match.note: Developer covers the build; dental workflows, HIPAA and B2B sales are new.

capital_needed.note: $2,000 covers a pilot on Open Dental; Dentrix write access costs $10,000 one-time.

time_to_mvp.note: First paid pilot ~8 weeks out (estimate): build, BAA, per-practice PMS access.

sales_cycle.note: The agency already has the trust

trend.note: +86% YoY search growth for 'AI receptionist' (DataForSEO via FindSkill, 2026).

free_alternatives.note: Quo includes 10 free AI calls/month; Weave bundles it. Free covers part, not PMS booking.

competitor_density.note: 20+ direct competitors found: Weave, Arini, Flossy, Dentina, Viva, TensorLinks, SmileDial...

differentiation.note: The only one booking into Open Dental

legal_regulatory.note: PHI on calls: BAAs needed across telephony, LLM, TTS and storage; TCPA for AI-voice callbacks.

platform_dependency.note: Depends on PMS API access per practice and on one voice-AI vendor's pricing.

market_risk.note: Durable need: 55% of dentists find admin hiring extremely/very hard (ADA HPI, 2025).

skills.note: Builds software; no dental, healthcare compliance or sales track record stated.

assets.note: No audience, dental network or data stated.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income; no domain interest stated.

blockers: Founder fit stays low: no dental network and little interest (fit 1.8/5)
Strong competitors keep competitor density at 1

plan.step: Write the 2-hour setup checklist and price page at $299 + $500
Run 2 pilot practices through the agency

kill_criteria: No agency agrees to a pilot after 10 pitches by 2026-12-01: stop
